IRS990.Desc: HEALTH:RESULTS FOR DEVELOPMENT PROVIDES EVIDENCE, ADVICE, SUPPORT AND CONNECTIONS TO CHANGE AGENTS AS THEY DRIVE THE PROGRESS NEEDED TO DELIVER HIGH-QUALITY, AFFORDABLE HEALTH SERVICES FOR ALL. KEY AREAS OF FOCUS INCLUDE HEALTH SYSTEM STRENGTHENING, HEALTH FINANCING, PRIMARY CARE, COMMUNITY HEALTH, INFORMATION SYSTEMS, AND LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: CROSS-CUTTING APPROACHES:R4D HAS DEEP EXPERTISE IN SEVERAL CROSS-CUTTING APPROACHES THAT ARE APPLIED TO OUR WORK IN HEALTH, EDUCATION AND NUTRITION RESULTING IN HIGHLY EFFECTIVE PROGRAMS. THESE INCLUDE COLLABORATIVE LEARNING (A PEER-TO-PEER LEARNING APPROACH WE PIONEERED), ADAPTIVE LEARNING (A RAPID-FEEDBACK, ITERATIVE APPROACH TO MAKE PROGRAMS MORE IMPACTFUL), SCALING INNOVATIONS, EVIDENCE-INFORMED DECISION-MAKING; MARKET SHAPING, AND ACCOUNTABILITY AND CITIZEN ENGAGEMENT.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: EDUCATION:RESULTS FOR DEVELOPMENT WORKS WITH CHANGE AGENTS TO STRENGTHEN THEIR EDUCATION SYSTEMS BY PROVIDING ANALYSIS, SUPPORT AND CONNECTIONS, WHILE GENERATING KEY EVIDENCE AND PUTTING IT INTO ACTION. KEY AREAS OF FOCUS INCLUDE EDUCATION TECHNOLOGY, TEACHER PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT, EARLY CHILDHOOD DEVELOPMENT AND PARENT/COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: NUTRITION:RESULTS FOR DEVELOPMENT WORK WITH CHANGE AGENTS TO FINANCE AND ADDRESS URGENT MALNUTRITION CHALLENGES. KEY AREAS OF FOCUS INCLUDE NUTRITION FINANCING, USING DATA FOR DECISION-MAKING, AND SHAPING MARKETS AND FOOD SYSTEMS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS APPROVED A CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY AT THEIR OCTOBER 28, 2009 MEETING. THE BOARD MEMBERS REVIEW THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY ANNUALLY. TO ENSURE THE RESULTS FOR DEVELOPMENT INSTITUTE OPERATES IN A MANNER CONSISTENT WITH CHARITABLE PURPOSES AND DOES NOT ENGAGE IN ACTIVITIES THAT COULD JEOPARDIZE ITS TAX-EXEMPT STATUS, PERIODIC REVIEWS SHALL BE CONDUCTED. THE PERIODIC REVIEWS SHALL, AT A MINIMUM, INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING SUBJECTS: WHETHER COMPENSATION ARRANGEMENTS AND BENEFITS ARE REASONABLE, BASED ON COMPETENT SURVEY INFORMATION, AND THE RESULT OF ARM'S LENGTH BARGAINING, AND WHETHER PARTNERSHIPS, JOINT VENTURES, AND ARRANGEMENTS WITH MANAGEMENT ORGANIZATIONS CONFORM TO R4D'S WRITTEN POLICIES, ARE PROPERLY RECORDED, REFLECT REASONABLE INVESTMENT OR PAYMENTS FOR GOODS AND SERVICES, FURTHER CHARITABLE PURPOSES AND DO NOT RESULT IN INUREMENT, IMPERMISSIBLE PRIVATE BENEFIT OR IN AN EXCESS BENEFIT TRANSACTION. IF THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE DETERMINES THE MEMBER HAS FAILED TO DISCLOSE AN ACTUAL OR POSSIBLE CONFLICT OF INTEREST, IT SHALL TAKE APPROPRIATE DISCIPLINARY AND CORRECTIVE ACTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS REVIEWS AND APPROVES THE PRESIDENT'S COMPENSATION ON AN ANNUAL BASIS. THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS COMMISSIONED A REPORT FROM AN INDEPENDENT CONSULTANT IN 2018 TO ENSURE THE APPROPRIATENESS OF THE COMPENSATION LEVELS OF THE MANAGING DIRECTORS AND THE PRESIDENT. IN 2018, THE R4D MANAGEMENT UNDERTOOK A REVIEW OF AN INDEPENDENTLY PRODUCED COMPENSATION SURVEY OF OTHER NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS OF SIMILAR SIZE AND SCOPE TO R4D TO ENSURE THE APPROPRIATENESS OF THE COMPENSATION LEVELS OF ITS STAFF. ANNUALLY R4D MANAGEMENT REVIEWS THE SALARY OF ITS STAFF AND COMPENSATION OF R4D MANAGING DIRECTORS AND ALL STAFF SALARIES ARE APPROVED BY THE PRESIDENT. IN NOVEMBER 2019, THE BOARD REVIEWED THE PRESIDENT'S EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT AND RENEWED THIS CONTRACT FOR AN ADDITIONAL YEAR TO BE REVIEWED ANNUALLY HENCEFORTH. THE MOST RECENT REVIEW WAS CONDUCTED IN JANUARY 2025. THE RESULTS OF THE ANNUAL REVIEW SHALL BE AN INPUT TO THE DETERMINATION OF EXECUTIVE'S COMPENSATION.
